title: Build and retain a 330 mm electrode-slitter knife cassette for a mixed-width recipe
instruction: Assemble and retain the pilot electrode-slitter cassette on the vertical service arbor. Build the 330 mm stack so its four blade cutting faces are at 50, 125, 205 and 280 mm above the shoulder. Apply the 500 N axial clamp, release the handling head and pass the three-second 100 N / 2 Nm retention test. Leave clamp and proof on. Do not drop tooling off the table. Initial magazine parts: part_0 spacer h=50 mm at (0.40,0.00,0.82500) m; part_1 blade h=2 mm at (0.24,-0.25,0.80100) m; part_2 spacer h=73 mm at (0.24,0.25,0.83650) m; part_3 blade h=2 mm at (0.56,-0.25,0.80100) m; part_4 spacer h=78 mm at (0.56,0.25,0.83900) m; part_5 blade h=2 mm at (0.40,-0.25,0.80100) m; part_6 spacer h=73 mm at (0.24,0.00,0.83650) m; part_7 blade h=2 mm at (0.56,0.00,0.80100) m; part_8 spacer h=48 mm at (0.40,0.25,0.82400) m.
context: Offline assembly of the lower knife cassette sets the electrode slitter cut positions. The task checks every internal position and released mechanical retention, not cutting quality.
setup: World Z up, units m unless stated. A fixed service arbor diameter 64.8 mm, length 400 mm stands at X=Y=0 from Z=0.800 to 1.200; the square 140x140x50 mm shoulder has its top at Z=0.800. The steel bench top is 1.10x1.10x0.06 centred at (0.25,0,0.72), with four 50x50x690 mm legs; floor is 3x3x0.1 at Z=-0.05. Nine tooling rings have 65 mm bores: four tungsten-carbide lower knives diameter 100 mm, thickness 2 mm, nominal density 14500 kg/m3, plus five steel spacers diameter 80 mm and lengths 50,73,78,73,48 mm, density 7850 kg/m3. Each mass is the actual annular volume times density. The instruction lists all initial ring centres; each sits on a diameter 76x50 mm pedestal with top Z=0.800. Two 73 mm spacers and identical blades are interchangeable. The powered, anchored 150 kg gantry frame has four 60x60x1600 mm corner posts at X=-0.28/0.80,Y=+/-0.60, 160 mm square feet, two X rails 1140x60x80 mm at Z=1.5, roof rails 1140x60x60 mm at Z=1.63, and a 160x1220x60 mm press crosshead at X=0,Z=1.63. X/Y carriages are 5 kg each; the open-centre handling head is 2 kg plus three 0.1 kg radial jaws. Palm ID70/OD150 mm x20 mm thick is 60 mm above jaw centre; each pad is 4x8x30 mm, with 4x8x50 mm fingers above. Jaw centres start 60 mm radially out at 0/120/240 degrees, with a 23 mm inward stroke and 50 N drive each. The actual bore uses 96 convex annular sectors, never a filled cylinder. XYZ axes use native 3 MN/m,15 kNs/m drives, 1 kN effort limit and 0.40 m/s maximum speed. The 1 kg annular pressure platen ID65/OD100 mm x20 mm has its reference centre at Z=1.20, a -90..+50 mm native vertical stroke, 20 mm/s speed and 500 N downward command. It retracts upward with a 1 kN command. A 3 kg lateral pressure carriage starts at Y=-0.45 m, with 0.10 m/s maximum speed, 3 MN/m stiffness, 15 kNs/m damping and 1 kN effort cap. The platen begins at its fully raised +50 mm joint position, centre Z=1.250, 40 mm above the shaft top. Its native PLC waits for full vertical retraction before any lateral travel, then aligns at Y=0 before lowering. Clamp 0 raises before parking, using actual encoders. Park the handling head at (0.60,0.40,1.35) before clamping. The carriage block is 160x240x40 mm at reference Z=1.60. Physics uses 480 Hz discrete steps, 24 substeps per control action. Visible drive covers/rods add no collision or mass. Robot USD lists all carriage, bracket and rod offsets. Contact material friction is 0.65 static/0.50 dynamic. Initial head XYZ=(-0.15,-0.4,1.35), jaws open, press retracted, proof off; settle 2 s under gravity. Cameras at (1.3,-1.5,1.9) looking at (0.20,0,0.85), and (0.35,-0.45,1.30) looking at (0,0,1.0), each 1280x720. A 5 um-resolution ideal axial profile gauge reports installed blade heights in order; pad/platen normal-force gauges and joint encoders accompany RGB. Proof applies +25 N Z and +0.5 Nm Z to each free blade. The physics device is CPU, with PGS solver and continuous collision detection enabled on the scene and every free ring. Native audit checks these flags before policy actions. The clamp gauge measures only the upward Z contact force exerted by the final 48 mm spacer on the platen, using a native body-pair filter; shaft/lateral contacts are excluded. Tooling, shaft, pedestals and machine colliders use a 20 um contact-generation offset and zero rest offset. The loaded-contact diagnostic must verify the actual face positions and forces at these settings. The native machine articulation and free tooling request 64 position-solver iterations and one velocity iteration. This numerical setting requires fresh loaded-contact validation. Analytic uniform-ring inertias are explicit, with central mass origins. RTX rendering supplies both native RGB streams. This isolated CPU/CCD source requires fresh native validation.
scoring: Final current outcome, no accumulated partial credit: 0.25 for all nine parts face-seated on the arbor (adjacent faces and shoulder within 0.05 mm), centred within 0.15 mm, axes within 0.2 degrees of vertical, and all four blade lower faces at 50/125/205/280 mm within 0.05 mm. Every part must be stable (linear speed <1.5 mm/s, angular speed <0.05 rad/s) and the head clear: lateral centre distance >=180 mm or lowest pad >30 mm above both stack and platen. 0.5 also requires actual upward final-spacer/platen contact >=300 N and its lower face within 0.1 mm of the stack top and its lateral centre within 0.15 mm of the arbor. 1 also requires the actual 100 N / 2 Nm total proof and all those conditions continuously for 3 s; each blade moves <=0.05 mm and rotates <=1 degree from the interval baseline. Slip fails that proof request until proof is turned off. Missing/malformed/nonfinite state, any part below Z=0.70 or outside |X|<0.9,|Y|<0.65 latches zero until reset. Other outcomes score zero. Identical parts may exchange identity and circular yaw is irrelevant except during the loaded retention interval. Measure with axial metrology, force gauges, the red angular witnesses and a timer.
run_limit: 2400 control steps (120 s at 20 Hz); at most 30 LLM calls, each selecting 1..400 bounded actions
reset_notes: Return all nine free parts to their source pedestals, restore native joints and zero velocities, open jaws, raise and park the platen at Y=-0.45 m, remove proof forces and clear scorer history; settle for 2 s. No consumables.
fidelity: CPU PhysX/PGS with CCD and 480 Hz physics; RTX native RGB. Actual-size 100x65x2 mm free knives and steel spacers use hollow 96-sector colliders and analytic ring inertias. Contact-only native jaws/platen; no attachments or pose trajectories. Custom service fit, friction, drives and ideal gauges. Rigid tooling excludes elasticity, damage, cutting and wear. The 500 N clamp and 100 N/2 Nm proof are unchanged. Native feasibility pending.
scores: Native demo/model evaluation pending; no physics success claimed.
